description: JS/TS/Node layer. Applied on top of default.json.

packageRules.description: Ranges are updated through the lockfile and releases are filtered by engines.node. Scoped to the npm manager so that the preset also works in a mixed repo (JS + JVM) and does not touch Maven/Gradle dependencies.
Tools that are configuration themselves — a major always goes through a human, one PR per major.
Playwright moves as a single whole — the package, core and the Docker image have to match.
Cypress and its plugins too — the plugins have a narrow peer range on the Cypress version.
Tailwind together with the bundler plugin.
TypeScript has no semver for types — a minor can break compilation, hence the long quarantine.
The overrides block is a security policy, not a dependency — Renovate does not touch it.
